build_colwise_parallel: build a ColwiseParallel config to shard nn.Linear or nn.Embedding weights column-wise with replicated input
build_rowwise_parallel: build a RowwiseParallel config to shard nn.Linear weights row-wise with sharded input and replicated output
build_prepare_module_input: build a PrepareModuleInput config to convert module inputs to DTensors and redistribute to desired layouts
build_prepare_module_output: build a PrepareModuleOutput config to convert module outputs to DTensors and redistribute to desired layouts
review_parallel_style: review the ParallelStyle abstract base class that defines the apply contract for parallelize_module
